subject: Still have hopes for blur...
author: ZombieTron
body:
although I gather it has been put back to next year now?? I thought it was going to be out this side of Christmas???

knowing how much CG changed/added to Paradise in the last few months of development anything could happen to either of these titles before they are released next year... so this review is possibly a little premature??

Split/Second still looks fun, even tho I doubt it will be a game I play online everyday for 2 years! 🙂
